articles.title: The Lost Land Beneath the Sea
articles.summary: Geographer Jerome E. Dobson calls the drowned Ice Age land Aquaterra. Sunken settlements may hold clues to early human history.

articles.title: When the Sea Turns Cold, Rescuers Rush to Save Sea Turtles
articles.summary: When cold water leaves sea turtles dazed and numb, beach patrollers rush them to special hospitals for slow warming and care.

articles.title: A Giant Computer Simulation Lights Up the Universe's Dark Age
articles.summary: Lumina, a huge new simulation from MIT and Harvard, recreates 2 billion years of early cosmic history and shows how the first stars and feeding black holes ended the universe's dark age.
